title: The Ski Bus at its depot
notes: Ski Bus Depot (2666.6, 797.9, -1713.0). Camera on the snow bank beside the sidewalk, 1.6 m up, looking southwest along the street at the shelter and the SKI BUS pylon, a 2 m truck. The coach (SkiCoachBus) drives in from the A-Frame (route through (2709, -1660), (2675, -1688)), stops at about (2663, -1708), turns at (2659, -1701) and drives out through (2675, -1693), 4 m from the camera's right side. One cycle takes about 40 s real at sim speed 1. Start when the inbound coach passes x 2725 to 2700; a 12 s path covers the arrival; the departure came 1 s after the path ended. Pedestrians use the sidewalk: keep the camera off it. Capture mode (fps 30, capture 60).
